designEvidence.brief: 原创竞技战斗 HUD：身份与目标在上方形成对向信息带，任务/警报位于侧栏，战斗状态居中，技能操作固定在安全区底部。

layoutDecisions.decision: player and target panels are separate top siblings; center status owns the combat objective axis
layoutDecisions.reason: 避免目标信息和技能操作争夺同一视觉层级。

layoutDecisions.decision: top panels and quest feed stack vertically while action bar becomes a four-column grid
layoutDecisions.reason: 保留触控尺寸并避免宽屏 HUD 等比缩小。

layoutDecisions.decision: flow/grid parents own child geometry for action and quest groups
layoutDecisions.reason: 消除布局组与子节点绝对 bounds 的双重解释。

conflictHypotheses: long target names may collide with health bars
narrow quest rows may require a scroll fallback
loading and error copy must preserve the center status rectangle
action bar must remain inside safe-area inset

expectedEffects: screen family and primary intent are unchanged
visual target and fidelity/reference policy are unchanged
the regenerated packet keeps the source layout and design contracts
falsificationChecks: fresh wide and narrow default GPU captures
spec hash and generated-art build ID match

assumptions.statement: 重建暂不重新发明屏幕语义；它只刷新物化身份并继承源合同，避免需求漂移。
